run_translate_files: run fairseq-interactive translation on input files using a model checkpoint with specified source and target languages
run_translate_local_backend: run translation jobs locally across multiple GPUs using multiprocessing with a GPU queue for device assignment
run_translate_slurm_backend: run translation jobs on a SLURM cluster by submitting sbatch jobs with GPU resources and waiting for completion
run_split_and_translate: run file splitting and batch translation with chunking, skipping already finished translation jobs to resume partial work
run_aggregate_translations: run aggregation of translated output files to generate paired source and hypothesis files from fairseq interactive logs
